subject: bus error with ChromosomeExplorer and zoom x64

messages.author: 67dd8164f9bfa181
messages.subject: bus error with ChromosomeExplorer and zoom x64
parts:
Dear all,

I have frequently bus errors when running ChromosomeExplorer for
graphics generation, and a zoom level of x64. I encountered it first
with 6.0 arrays and few cases, but also with >30 cases in the 500k
setting.

A similar problem had been mentioned before (didn't find the
discussion ...).

Setting the max. zoom to x32 works.

Btw., could you suggest alternative methods for plotting from the glad/
cbs output?

Comments appreciated!

Best,

Michael.

8-core Intel, 8GB RAM, Mac OS X.

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: bus error with ChromosomeExplorer and zoom x64
parts:
Hi,

your aroma.affymetrix is outdated. However, I don't think that is the
cause for you error, but rather it is the PNG device driver that gives
the error. This is unrelated to aroma.affymetrix, but is rather an R
issue. The reason why you observe it with aroma.affymetrix is most
likely because it generates *heaps* of PNGs and manage to "torture"
the device driver to the point where a bug is revealed.

Depending on your system setup, there are a few different PNG drivers
that R have access to. It might be that one of the others don't give
these problems. You can override the findPngDevice() method to
force/fool aroma.affymetrix to use another one. You find more
information on how to do this in thread 'ChromosomeExplorer memory
leaks' started on Aug 18, 2008:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/browse_thread/thread/e06bc012b5359dea/6bf7aed8832b0eb5

Hope this helps

Henrik
